articleHero.headline: What Is Foot Reflexology Good For?
articleHero.directAnswer: Foot reflexology applies gentle pressure to specific points on the feet for a deeply relaxing experience. It is a favorite after long days on your feet, done fully clothed from the ankle up in our recliner lounge.

richText.body:
## What it is
Reflexology focuses on the feet with pressure-point work that many find calming and restorative.

## Why people love it
It is a low-key, comfortable treatment — perfect after a long shift or a lot of walking, and an easy first spa experience.

## What to expect
You relax in a recliner, clothed from the ankle up, while your therapist works on your feet. Sessions run 30 or 60 minutes.
